Introduction

Signal was a 4-member boy group under J Star Entertainment consisting of Kyuhwan, Gihwan, Youngho, and Bokeun. The group made their official debut August 28, 2019 with the mini-album "The First Signal: Begins"

The members left J star Entertainment since 2019 and joined elmusix in 2021.

They officially disbanded on June 1st 2021 after all members decided to go their own paths.
